scripts.start: npx rimraf .angular .vite node_mzodules && npm install && ng serve
scripts.git:patch:push: bash -c 'read -p "branch: " BRANCH && npm run git:patch && git push --follow-tags origin HEAD:refs/heads/$BRANCH'
scripts.git:minor:push: bash -c 'read -p "branch: " BRANCH && npm run git:minor && git push --follow-tags origin HEAD:refs/heads/$BRANCH'
scripts.git:major:push: bash -c 'read -p "branch: " BRANCH && npm run git:major && git push --follow-tags origin HEAD:refs/heads/$BRANCH'
